change_summary: Added an audit-only runner that replays the accepted A+B stack, isolates breakout_long losses, and records repeated false-positive families plus winner collateral.
hypothesis: The accepted stack's breakout losers still cluster into a reproducible false-positive subfamily that can be counted without changing strategy logic.
notes: Artifact: data/exp_20260426_007_breakout_failure_audit.json. Cross-window result: the clean repeated zero-collateral breakout loser family is reduced_risk | earnings_proximity (4 losses, .11, three windows, zero winners). A second smaller zero-collateral family is reduced_risk | gap_sensitive+near_high (2 losses, .83, two windows). The largest loss bucket by dollars is full_risk | plain fast reversal (.90), but it carries 14 winners worth .69, so it is not a clean cut candidate. LLM entry archive coverage stayed 0/8 and news archive was missing on 7/8 losses, so semantic explanation remains a measurement gap rather than a rejected mechanism.
